limitations: No model evaluation, calibration, expected win probability, player availability model or draft-success validation was performed.
All alternative rank, minutes, prior-strength and roster outputs are declared deterministic stress cases, not probability estimates or claims of edge.
RotoWire's saved public rank data is points-league scoped; stale rank ordering is shown only as a research fallback and is not treated as current global ranking.
Unmatched names and source gaps remain explicit review items; no name-only identity is imported or rehearsed.
The frozen baseline and source timestamps remain intact; only new versioned candidate artifacts are written.
